summary: Lane B2 is a SOURCE-KIND ruling (T25) only — by design this verdict produces no anchors, no continue points and no type changes, so target rows 1-25 take neither an anchor nor an anchor_hostile entry. The finding: the anime adapts the KOREAN WEBTOON '나 혼자만 레벨업' (Chugong original story / DUBU (REDICE STUDIO) art / h-goon script adaptation, D&C Media, serialised on KakaoPage 2018-03-04 to 2021-12-29, 179 main chapters + a 2023 side story to ch 200, collected in 15 Korean volumes) — NOT Chugong's 2016-2018 web novel. Three independent lines agree: (a) AniList's ONLY ADAPTATION edge from anime 151807 is manga node 105398, countryOfOrigin KR, format MANGA; (b) the official 原作 credit on the anime is the webtoon's own three-name credit trio 'DUBU (REDICE STUDIO)、Chugong、h-goon（D&C MEDIA 発行）' — the novel alone would be credited to Chugong; (c) sololeveling.fandom's per-episode 'adaptedFrom' field carries TWO labelled spaces, {{WB}} webtoon and {{NV}} webnovel, and the 13 stored anchors reproduce the {{WB}} column exactly. Recommendation: SOURCE_TYPE_OVERRIDES solo-leveling → 'manhwa' (already a registered kind, unit chapter, badge 'manhwa only'); the stored source_type 'other' is only an artefact of AniList's `source: OTHER` on the anime media — with `source: MANGA` the existing derivation (MANGA × KR) would return 'manhwa' with no override needed.

structure.notes:
THE WORK (T25). Source = the Korean webtoon 나 혼자만 레벨업 / 俺だけレベルアップな件 — original story Chugong, art DUBU (Jang Sung-rak, REDICE STUDIO), script adaptation Gi So-Ryeong (2018-19) then h-goon (2019-23); publisher D&C Media (D&C Webtoon Biz.); serialised on KakaoPage 2018-03-04 → 2021-12-29 (Japanese edition on Piccoma 2019-03-01 → 2022-01-21, later LINE Manga). NOT the source: Chugong's web novel (KakaoPage 2016-07-25 → 2018-04-18, 13 main volumes + 1 side-story volume, ja-WP 『概要』), which is a VOLUME/chapter-in-volume space, not our chapter space.

COUNT AND NUMBERING UNIT. Unit = webtoon CHAPTER, plain integers, one continuous run. Main story = ch 1-179 (ja-WP infobox 話数=全179話; en-WP 'concluding on December 29, 2021 with its 179th chapter'). A side story (Chugong writing, new art team after DUBU's death) ran Jan–May 2023 and extends the same numbering to ch 200. Collected in 15 Korean volumes by D&C Media / 15 English volumes by Yen Press. sololeveling.fandom's Volume & Chapter table gives the full split: v1 1-12, v2 13-26, v3 27-44, v4 45-63, v5 64-81, v6 82-97, v7 98-110, v8 111-122, v9 123-134, v10 135-146, v11 147-158, v12 159-168, v13 169-179, v14 180-190, v15 191-200. Our stored volume boundary v7 = 98-110 matches that table EXACTLY — independent confirmation that our chapter space is the webtoon's own numbering.

ANILIST ADAPTATION EDGE. anime 151807 (source OTHER, JP) → relations: ADAPTATION → 105398 'Na Honjaman Level Up' (MANGA, KR, chapters 201, volumes 15, FINISHED); SEQUEL → 176496 (S2); SUMMARY → 184694 (ReAwakening recap film). The webtoon node's own edges list both TV seasons and both films as ADAPTATION, and SEQUEL → 179445 'Solo Leveling: Ragnarok'. There is NO AniList media entry for Chugong's web novel at all, so no novel edge exists to compete. Corroborating detail: the announced film 213846 'Beyond the System' carries `source: MANGA` — AniList's own newer entry in the same franchise names the manhwa as the source; the 'OTHER' on the two TV entries is the stale first-guess value.

WHAT FANS MAP EPISODES TO — AND THE STORED ANCHORS. sololeveling.fandom episode pages carry `adaptedFrom` with two explicitly templated spaces: {{WB}} = Solo Leveling (webtoon) and {{NV}} = Solo Leveling (webnovel) (Template:WB → [[Solo Leveling (webtoon)]], Template:NV → [[Solo Leveling (webnovel)]]). Sampled: ep1 'Chapter 1-4 {{WB}} / Vol. 1 Ch. 1 - Vol. 1 Ch. 2 {{NV}}'; ep2 '4-10 {{WB}} / Vol.1 Ch.2-3 {{NV}}'; ep3 '11-13 {{WB}}'; ep5 '18-21 {{WB}}'; ep8 '27-28 {{WB}}'; ep12 '41-45 {{WB}}'; ep13 '46-51 {{WB}}'; ep20 '82-87 {{WB}}'; ep24 '101-104 {{WB}}'; ep25 '104-110 {{WB}}'. Our 13 stored anchors (ep1→4[1], ep2→10[4], ep3→13[11], ep4→17[14], ep5→21[18], ep6→24[21], ep7→27[25], ep8→28[27], ep9→34[29], ep10→37[34], ep11→41[37], ep12→45[41]) reproduce the {{WB}} column exactly on every row I sampled. VERDICT ON THE SPACE: the 13 stored anchors are in the WEBTOON chapter space (1-200) and therefore MATCH the source named here. The novel space would be radically different (anime ep 1 = novel Vol.1 Ch.1-2, not ch 1-4).

LOCALISATION NOTE. ja-WP records that the Japanese edition changes the setting from Korea to a fictional island nation (DFN) and renames every character (Sung Jinwoo → 水篠旬); the anime uses the Japanese localisation's names. The chapter NUMBERING is identical across localisations (Piccoma ch N = KakaoPage ch N), so no conversion is needed — but the Japanese PRINT edition is a different volume split (KADOKAWA MFC, 23 volumes as of 2026-01 per ja-WP) and must never be used for volume boundaries; our v7 = 98-110 is correctly on the Korean / Yen Press 15-volume split.

flags_for_sean: RECOMMENDATION (T25): SOURCE_TYPE_OVERRIDES['solo-leveling'] = 'manhwa'. Already a registered kind (SOURCE_KINDS: value 'manhwa', noun 'manhwa', unit 'chapter', tailBadge 'manhwa only', countries ['KR']) — the registry needs NO new record. Rationale: this is AniList's `source: OTHER` on the ANIME being wrong, not a genuinely exotic source; the manga node 105398 is format MANGA × countryOfOrigin KR, so deriveSourceKind would already return 'manhwa' if the anime's source field read MANGA. Ruling 'manhwa' keeps the override aligned with the derivation instead of standing apart from it, and matches the god-of-high-school precedent (KR webtoon → manhwa once the node's country was fetched). Sources: https://anilist.co/anime/151807 · https://anilist.co/manga/105398 · https://www.aniplex.co.jp/lineup/sololeveling/ · https://animestore.docomo.ne.jp/animestore/ci_pc?workId=26802

ALTERNATIVE considered and rejected: 'webtoon' (the registry's reserved override-only kind). It fits the FORMAT (vertical-scroll SMARTOON on KakaoPage/Piccoma), but it discards the KR signal that 'manhwa' encodes and would put Solo Leveling in a different bucket from every other AniList-KR series in the catalog. I recommend reserving 'webtoon' for works that are NOT Korean — see the-beginning-after-the-end.json, where 'manhwa' would be factually wrong. If Sean prefers one bucket for both series, 'webtoon' for both is coherent; 'manhwa' for both is not (TBATE is an OEL American Tapas Original).

ALTERNATIVE rejected: 'web_novel' / 'novel'. The anime's official 原作 credit is the webtoon's three-name trio and names D&C MEDIA / D&C Webtoon Biz. as the publisher; the novel would be credited to Chugong alone. Every fan mapping and all 13 stored anchors are in webtoon chapter numbers. No AniList entry for the novel exists.

CHAPTER-COUNT DISCREPANCY (not this lane's ask, but it touches tail math): our stored total_chapters = 201 / latest_known = 201, inherited from AniList node 105398. The publication's own numbering ends at ch 200 (sololeveling.fandom Volume & Chapter: v15 = ch 191-200), and the MAIN story ends at ch 179 (ja-WP 全179話; en-WP '179th chapter'), with 180-200 being the 2023 side story. AniList's 201 is one unit over — likely a prologue or notice counted. Worth a G-family look before any 'N chapters remain' figure is shown.

POSSIBLE BAD CONTINUE POINT (flagging, not repairing — this lane emits no repairs): stored ep25 → continue_chapter 104 from the afg-continua table. sololeveling.fandom gives ep 24 = webtoon ch 101-104 and ep 25 = webtoon ch 104-110, i.e. 104 is INSIDE ep 25's own range, and ch 110 is exactly the end of volume 7 (our stored v7 boundary). Under C5 (post-series = furthest first-time coverage + 1) the honest resume after the anime is ch 111 / start of vol 8, not 104. Recommend routing this to an anchors lane with the fandom episode pages as evidence: https://sololeveling.fandom.com/api.php?action=parse&page=Episode_25&prop=wikitext&format=json

SOURCE NOTE for whoever anchors this series next: sololeveling.fandom's per-episode adaptedFrom is a genuinely good per-episode source (two labelled chapter spaces, {{WB}}/{{NV}}), it agrees with our stored afg anchors on every row I sampled (eps 1,2,3,5,8,12), and it extends past our frontier to eps 13-25. Its {{NV}} column is mostly 'Chapter ? - Chapter ?' from ep 13 on and must not be used.
